causal_question: Does the seed-1 near-parity of the compact full-MLP Pair-VQ representation replicate under a second matched initialization and data-order seed while retaining the exact adaptive compact optimizer state?

frozen_pair.parent: QK-only mapped attention with dense MLP
frozen_pair.candidate: same QK-only mapped attention with complete Pair-VQ MLP, forward-visible compact feedback, c_proj fast residual, FP16 ambient Muon history, and adaptive block-local exact momentum coding

systems.checkpoint_policy: no checkpoints for this paired statistical qualification because transition/resume and state identity are already sealed and PRO6 has less than 1.4 GB project-cap headroom
systems.monitoring: Each run exceeds five minutes and requires a verified persistent terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog. The parent runs first; the candidate is launched only after parent terminal verification.

decision_rule.pass: The seed-2 candidate is no more than 0.05 CE above its matched parent, compute-equivalent penalty is no more than 1.10x, all state and systems gates pass, and the paired mean remains below 0.05 CE.
decision_rule.fail: Do not scale. Localize whether the failure is initialization variance, compact forward representation, or adaptive-state capacity using the fixed checkpoints in the two logs.
decision_rule.after_pass: Seal an uncertainty-qualified two-seed 124M compact full-MLP result. Return to the full-attention V/c_proj problem before any model-size scale-up.
forbidden: running the parent and candidate with different data order or eval indices
changing the MLP representation or optimizer between the pair
model-size scale-up before the paired result
using PRO6 checkpoints that breach the 256 GiB project cap
